_about: Limits of the game. entities: the most entities in the world state of one map (Phù Đổng has about 120); the laws of the world check it on every step of every story (src/core/story.js). figureParts: the most parts of one figure of each kind at the fine level of detail (src/world/fine.js); all parts of all figures draw as one instanced mesh, so the count is the cost. frameTriangles: the most triangles of the world (the ground, the things, the smooth looks, and their ink) in the three by three chunks around the start of a place (src/world/chunks.js); a test checks it at every place. viewTriangles and viewCalls: the most triangles and draw calls of a frame, as the ?fps line counts them: all the meshes of the chunks in the view (the ink included), in their blocks of 2 x 2 chunks, at the far zoom on the screen that sees the most, plus viewExtra (the figures and the sky); a test checks them on the walk from Phù Đổng to Sóc Sơn and at the densest places (the hill forest at the south edge, Tam Đảo, and Ba Vì). liveChunks: the most live chunks (where the entities move and the systems run) around the hero; the laws of the world check it on every step of every story.
